Title: Master Phase Action vs Master Card Play

Messages.Author: DJ Monet
Messages.Body:
O.k., suppose Anson is up, you have the Parthenon, and Anson pases the
Rumors of Gehenna vote. Consider the wording on each card:

Anson : Can play 2 master cards each turn
Parth: additional master phase action
Rumors: can play two masters

How many pool can the player pull off of a Powerbase in a turn? Only
two (one for the player, one for the Parth) but would be allowed to
play two Master cards?
That's what it seems to say. I'm sure this has come up before...

Thanks-

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
DJ Monet wrote:
>
> O.k., suppose Anson is up, you have the Parthenon, and Anson pases the
> Rumors of Gehenna vote. Consider the wording on each card:
>
> Anson : Can play 2 master cards each turn

Anson: Get two master phase actions each master phase.

> Parth: additional master phase action
> Rumors: can play two masters

Rumors: Each chosen methuselah gets two MPAs each master phase.

> How many pool can the player pull off of a Powerbase in a turn? Only
> two (one for the player, one for the Parth) but would be allowed to
> play two Master cards?

The player would have 2 MPAs (Anson/Rumors) plus the ability
to gain one additional MPA each master phase. If the powerbase is activated
with MPAs, then there you go.

Messages.Author: Smenkhkapep
Messages.Body:
mjoh...@earthlink.net (DJ Monet) wrote:

> How many pool can the player pull off of a Powerbase in a turn? Only
> two (one for the player, one for the Parth) but would be allowed to
> play two Master cards?
> That's what it seems to say. I'm sure this has come up before...
>

The wording for Anson goes:

If Anson is ready, you get 2 master phase actions (instead of 1)
<during your master phase>.

Generally, such cards that allow you to play more Master cards
actually give you a 'Master phase action'. In the example given, you
can pull out (up to) three pool from a Powerbase.

Messages.Author: lactamaeon
Messages.Body:


Both Anson and Rumors allow two master phase actions (instead of the
usual one).

The Parthenon would give you one more.

You may take a total of three master phase actions, be they master
cards from hands or those allowed by cards in play.

lactamaeon

Messages.Author: DJ Monet
Messages.Body:
newq...@rose-hulman.edu (lactamaeon) wrote in message news:<786c1f73.02021...@posting.google.com>...


So, strategically, there is no need to have Anson AND Rumors... since
they both only give you 2, and they are not additive, ie. there's no
way to have more than 3 MPAs per turn (with these cards).

Thanks all for your input.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <c5f82717.02021...@posting.google.com>, DJ Monet

<mjoh...@earthlink.net> writes:
>So, strategically, there is no need to have Anson AND Rumors... since
>they both only give you 2, and they are not additive, ie. there's no
>way to have more than 3 MPAs per turn (with these cards).

If you have both in play then you will have 2 MPAs.

This is not the same as there never being any need. Having both in play
could, for instance, allow you better defence - if Anson gets rushed and
dies, you still have two MPAs, similarly if someone else is good at
burning the Rumors on their actions (e.g. Awe or something).
